messages:
Maria (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about the reorg and hiring. Dropping clarifications here so folks can DM if needed.

Sam (SWE): Will active interview loops be paused? I have two candidates in onsites.

Anita (People Ops): No pauses for candidates already in onsites or offer stage. Continue interviews; mark the intake form with 'in-flight' to expedite approvals.

Chris (VP Eng): Hiring focus for Q2: reliability, infra, and customer ops. Other reqs will be deprioritized but not nuked.

Devon (Head of Product): Roadmap owners: most stay the same. A small set of infra-heavy items will be reassigned to new stewards. We'll post an owner delta CSV tomorrow.

Sam (SWE): If my team gets a new steward, do we need to rebase our sprint?

Chris (VP Eng): No immediate sprint rebases. Any scope or priority changes will be coordinated and communicated by product owners — expect a short transition overlap.

Anita (People Ops): Manager hiring: few slots available, prioritized for teams >9 ICs or critical leadership gaps. Internal manager promotions are being fast-tracked where there's a strong fit.

Sam (SWE): Org chart ETA? Need names for planning.

Devon (Head of Product): Draft org map tomorrow AM; final by next Tue EOD. CSV mapping in handbook.

Maria (CEO): Intent reminder: the reorg aims to reduce handoffs and speed delivery. We prefer voluntary moves and six weeks of shadowing before formal reassignment.

Recruiter Bot: Hiring rubric + intake form -> https://internal.redwood/hire-intake. Use tag: q2-priority.

Anita (People Ops): Office hours this Thu 11:00 and Fri 15:00 PT. Book via People Ops calendar.

Maria (CEO): Thanks all. We'll pin the follow-up doc once org artifacts are live. If you have sensitive concerns, DM People Ops or your manager.
